source.title: Veteran's Battlegear
source.description:
The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, <name>.

You'd be wise to hold on to them.  As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
source.objective: Bring 7 Cenarion Combat Badges, 4 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 4 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
source.progress: It's in our best interest to keep our most loyal allies well geared, <name>.
source.completion: Great work, <name>.  Please accept this on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.  You've certainly earned it, friend!
